arStrings.szText: "Why have you been looking for me? Your notice mentioned the Mother's Faithful."
Don’t flatter yourself. I’m not after you. I came for Lilith’s Blood. But...by the Mother.
Mildly hostile towards the PLAYER. Shocked and appalled when she senses Lilith's blood is gone.
I don’t sense it on you. Ugh, I was so sure you were the one. Oh, you’re useless then.
